author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Build a device-neutral PS2 library restoration manifest
summary: Record titles, serials, regions, revisions, disc relationships, relative paths, bytes, SHA-256, storage roles, and verification dates so another Android device can reconstruct roots without copying stale URIs.
heroAlt: PCSX2 macOS setup wizard showing BIOS and game-directory selections that a restoration manifest must map on another device

blocks.text: Document intent, not Android's current URI

Storage Access Framework URIs belong to a particular Android user, provider, volume, and selection. Another phone cannot restore that identifier directly. A useful manifest records human and cryptographic identity plus a device-neutral relative path and storage role. The new device then recreates folders and grants its own URIs.
Do not put BIOS bytes, image contents, account tokens, or private absolute user paths in a portable manifest. It should describe and verify owner-controlled data, not embed it.

items: One row format used for every working image and component.
Verified SHA-256 and byte sizes.
Game serial, region, revision, and disc number where known.
Storage-role vocabulary such as Active, Preservation, Backup, Quarantine.
Separate sections for library roots, BIOS references, cards, and profile exports.
1. Assign each planned root a stable logical name such as Internal-Active or SD-Archive, not a device URI.
2. Record each image's path relative to that logical root.
3. Add exact bytes, SHA-256, serial, region, revision, and set membership.
4. For cue/bin sets, list the cue and every referenced track under one set identifier.
5. Record root purpose, filesystem, capacity, and last verification date.
6. List memory-card and profile backup artifacts in a separate private section without mixing them into game scans.
7. Test the manifest by reconstructing a small root in an empty staging folder and comparing its hashes.
8. On the destination device, create new folders, copy verified files, and grant each root through Android's picker.

blocks.text: CSV is convenient for sorting, while JSON can preserve nested disc sets; either is acceptable if it remains readable without a proprietary service. Keep a human-readable schema note beside the file and version changes rather than silently reusing columns.
A document is complete only when it can guide a small real restore without hidden assumptions.

items: Every active file maps to one logical root and relative path.
Hashes and bytes identify content independently of filename.
Regional and multidisc relationships are explicit.
No Android URI is treated as portable.
A staged subset restores, hashes, and cold-boots from the manifest.
Only absolute paths are stored: another provider cannot reproduce them.
Titles exist without serials or hashes: regional conflicts remain ambiguous.
Cue files are listed without tracks: CD sets are incomplete.
Active and backup copies have no roles: deduplication can remove the wrong one.

blocks.text: Version the manifest instead of overwriting history

If a migration exposes missing fields, keep the previous manifest read-only, add a new schema version, and regenerate affected rows from verified sources. Do not change hashes or identities to make a failed destination appear consistent.

A public-style library manifest can omit sensitive paths and firmware details. Store the private companion containing backup locations and BIOS references in an encrypted user-controlled archive, then verify a test extraction separately.
